title: Claude Project Downloader - Chrome Web Store
excerpt: Export Claude project files, instructions, chats, attachments, and artifacts.
content_html:
Overview

Export Claude project files, instructions, chats, attachments, and artifacts.

📦 Claude Project Exporter – Export Claude Chats, Projects & Files Export Claude chats, project files, attachments, artifacts, and knowledge base content in just a few clicks. Claude Project Exporter makes it easy to download and back up your Claude.ai conversations and projects directly from your browser. Export an individual Claude chat, save selected project files, or download an entire Claude project as a convenient ZIP archive. No more manually copying conversations or downloading project files one by one. Whether you want to create a local backup, archive important AI conversations, save research, preserve project knowledge, or move Claude content into another workflow, Claude Project Exporter gives you a simple and flexible way to keep your data organized. 🚀 1. Key Features ⚡ One-Click Claude Project Export Export the files from a Claude project with a single click. Claude Project Exporter helps you quickly save your Claude project knowledge base and uploaded files to your computer, making it useful for backups, archiving, research, documentation, and project management. 💬 Export Individual Claude Chats Need to save just one conversation? Download standalone Claude chats directly from the Claude page or from the extension popup. Supported chat export options include: 📄 Markdown (.md) – Great for readable archives, documentation, notes, and knowledge bases 🗂️ JSON (.json) – Ideal for structured data, developers, automation, and further processing 📦 ZIP (.zip) – Convenient for keeping a complete conversation and related content together This makes Claude Project Exporter useful as both a Claude chat exporter and a Claude conversation backup tool. 📦 Download an Entire Claude Project as ZIP Save your project content in one organized ZIP archive instead of downloading everything manually. The extension can bundle available project content, including: 📁 Project files 💬 Chat conversations 📎 Attachments 🎨 Generated artifacts 🖼️ Images 📑 PDFs and documents 💻 Code files 🧩 SVG artifacts A ZIP export is especially useful when you want to back up a Claude project locally, archive completed work, or keep an offline copy of important AI-generated content. 📥 Download Files Individually Don’t need the entire project? Claude Project Exporter also lets you download individual files so you can save only the content you actually need. This is useful for larger Claude projects where you may want to retrieve a specific document, attachment, image, code file, or other resource without exporting everything. 📝 Flexible Export Formats Choose the format that best fits your workflow. Claude Project Exporter can preserve original file extensions where appropriate while also allowing supported text content and conversations to be exported as Markdown files. Claude Project Exporter is designed to handle available attachments, binary files, PDFs, images, source code, documents, and generated SVG artifacts, helping you preserve more of the original Claude project instead of saving only the conversation text. 🧠 Smart Export Fallback Some Claude content may not always be directly downloadable through the available interface. When a file cannot be exported normally, Claude Project Exporter provides a ready-to-paste prompt that you can send to Claude to help retrieve the content. Instead of simply failing, the extension gives you another practical way to recover the information you need. 📋 2. How to Export a Claude Project Using Claude Project Exporter is simple: 1️⃣ Open Claude.ai Navigate to the Claude project or conversation you want to export. 2️⃣ Open Claude Project Exporter Click the extension icon in your Chrome toolbar, or use the available Download button displayed directly on the Claude page next to Share. 3️⃣ Choose What You Want to Export Select an individual chat, specific files, or the complete project. 4️⃣ Select Your Export Format Choose from available formats such as ZIP, Markdown, JSON, or the original file format. 5️⃣ Download Your Claude Content Save the exported content directly to your computer for backup, offline access, archiving, or further processing. That’s it. 🎉 🎯 3. What Can You Use Claude Project Exporter For? Claude Project Exporter is useful for anyone who regularly works with Claude projects and conversations. 💾 Back Up Claude Projects Keep local copies of important project files and conversations instead of relying exclusively on online access. 💬 Archive Claude Conversations Save valuable Claude chats for future reference, research, documentation, or record keeping. 🧠 Preserve Claude Project Knowledge Download available files from your Claude project knowledge base so important source material can be stored locally. 📚 Save Research & Writing Researchers, writers, students, and knowledge workers can archive Claude-assisted research, drafts, notes, and project materials. 💻 Export Developer Work Developers can save code discussions, generated files, technical documentation, JSON data, Markdown conversations, and other project resources. 🔄 Move Content Into Other Workflows Markdown and JSON exports make it easier to reuse your Claude conversations in note-taking systems, documentation tools, developer workflows, local archives, and other AI tools. 🗄️ Build an Offline Claude Archive Maintain your own organized collection of important Claude chats, project files, attachments, and generated content on your computer. 🔒 4. Privacy & Security Your Claude conversations and project files can contain sensitive information, so Claude Project Exporter is designed with privacy in mind. 🔐 Local processing – Export processing happens directly in your browser 🚫 No external upload servers – Your exported Claude content is not sent to our servers for processing 📊 No tracking or analytics – The extension does not track the contents of your Claude conversations 🔑 Uses your existing Claude session – No separate Claude username or password is required 💻 Direct downloads – Exported content is saved directly to your computer ✨ 5. A Faster Way to Export Claude.ai Content Manually copying long Claude conversations, saving attachments one at a time, and organizing project files can quickly become tedious. Claude Project Exporter simplifies the process by bringing Claude project export, Claude chat download, conversation backup, Markdown export, JSON export, attachment download, artifact export, and ZIP archiving into one convenient Chrome extension. Whether you’re backing up a single conversation or preserving an entire project, you can keep your Claude content accessible outside the browser with far less manual work. Install Claude Project Exporter and take control of your Claude.ai conversations, projects, files, and AI-generated work.

content_html_zh:
概述

Export Claude project files, instructions, chats, attachments, and artifacts.

📦 Claude Project Exporter – Export Claude Chats, Projects & Files Export Claude chats, project files, attachments, artifacts, and knowledge base content in just a few clicks. Claude Project Exporter makes it easy to download and back up your Claude.ai conversations and projects directly from your browser. Export an individual Claude chat, save selected project files, or download an entire Claude project as a convenient ZIP archive. No more manually copying conversations or downloading project files one by one. Whether you want to create a local backup, archive important AI conversations, save research, preserve project knowledge, or move Claude content into another workflow, Claude Project Exporter gives you a simple and flexible way to keep your data organized. 🚀 1. Key Features ⚡ One-Click Claude Project Export Export the files from a Claude project with a single click. Claude Project Exporter helps you quickly save your Claude project knowledge base and uploaded files to your computer, making it useful for backups, archiving, research, documentation, and project management. 💬 Export Individual Claude Chats Need to save just one conversation? Download standalone Claude chats directly from the Claude page or from the extension popup. Supported chat export options include: 📄 Markdown (.md) – Great for readable archives, documentation, notes, and knowledge bases 🗂️ JSON (.json) – Ideal for structured data, developers, automation, and further processing 📦 ZIP (.zip) – Convenient for keeping a complete conversation and related content together This makes Claude Project Exporter useful as both a Claude chat exporter and a Claude conversation backup tool. 📦 Download an Entire Claude Project as ZIP Save your project content in one organized ZIP archive instead of downloading everything manually. The extension can bundle available project content, including: 📁 Project files 💬 Chat conversations 📎 Attachments 🎨 Generated artifacts 🖼️ Images 📑 PDFs and documents 💻 Code files 🧩 SVG artifacts A ZIP export is especially useful when you want to back up a Claude project locally, archive completed work, or keep an offline copy of important AI-generated content. 📥 Download Files Individually Don’t need the entire project? Claude Project Exporter also lets you download individual files so you can save only the content you actually need. This is useful for larger Claude projects where you may want to retrieve a specific document, attachment, image, code file, or other resource without exporting everything. 📝 Flexible Export Formats Choose the format that best fits your workflow. Claude Project Exporter can preserve original file extensions where appropriate while also allowing supported text content and conversations to be exported as Markdown files. Claude Project Exporter is designed to handle available attachments, binary files, PDFs, images, source code, documents, and generated SVG artifacts, helping you preserve more of the original Claude project instead of saving only the conversation text. 🧠 Smart Export Fallback Some Claude content may not always be directly downloadable through the available interface. When a file cannot be exported normally, Claude Project Exporter provides a ready-to-paste prompt that you can send to Claude to help retrieve the content. Instead of simply failing, the extension gives you another practical way to recover the information you need. 📋 2. How to Export a Claude Project Using Claude Project Exporter is simple: 1️⃣ Open Claude.ai Navigate to the Claude project or conversation you want to export. 2️⃣ Open Claude Project Exporter Click the extension icon in your Chrome toolbar, or use the available Download button displayed directly on the Claude page next to Share. 3️⃣ Choose What You Want to Export Select an individual chat, specific files, or the complete project. 4️⃣ Select Your Export Format Choose from available formats such as ZIP, Markdown, JSON, or the original file format. 5️⃣ Download Your Claude Content Save the exported content directly to your computer for backup, offline access, archiving, or further processing. That’s it. 🎉 🎯 3. What Can You Use Claude Project Exporter For? Claude Project Exporter is useful for anyone who regularly works with Claude projects and conversations. 💾 Back Up Claude Projects Keep local copies of important project files and conversations instead of relying exclusively on online access. 💬 Archive Claude Conversations Save valuable Claude chats for future reference, research, documentation, or record keeping. 🧠 Preserve Claude Project Knowledge Download available files from your Claude project knowledge base so important source material can be stored locally. 📚 Save Research & Writing Researchers, writers, students, and knowledge workers can archive Claude-assisted research, drafts, notes, and project materials. 💻 Export Developer Work Developers can save code discussions, generated files, technical documentation, JSON data, Markdown conversations, and other project resources. 🔄 Move Content Into Other Workflows Markdown and JSON exports make it easier to reuse your Claude conversations in note-taking systems, documentation tools, developer workflows, local archives, and other AI tools. 🗄️ Build an Offline Claude Archive Maintain your own organized collection of important Claude chats, project files, attachments, and generated content on your computer. 🔒 4. Privacy & Security Your Claude conversations and project files can contain sensitive information, so Claude Project Exporter is designed with privacy in mind. 🔐 Local processing – Export processing happens directly in your browser 🚫 No external upload servers – Your exported Claude content is not sent to our servers for processing 📊 No tracking or analytics – The extension does not track the contents of your Claude conversations 🔑 Uses your existing Claude session – No separate Claude username or password is required 💻 Direct downloads – Exported content is saved directly to your computer ✨ 5. A Faster Way to Export Claude.ai Content Manually copying long Claude conversations, saving attachments one at a time, and organizing project files can quickly become tedious. Claude Project Exporter simplifies the process by bringing Claude project export, Claude chat download, conversation backup, Markdown export, JSON export, attachment download, artifact export, and ZIP archiving into one convenient Chrome extension. Whether you’re backing up a single conversation or preserving an entire project, you can keep your Claude content accessible outside the browser with far less manual work. Install Claude Project Exporter and take control of your Claude.ai conversations, projects, files, and AI-generated work.
